QuestInfo.name: Wind Archer Knighthood Exam
QuestInfo.0: According to #p1101002#, you can take the Knighthood Exam from Chief Knight of Wind #b#p1101005##k. Go to Ereve and meet #p1101005#.
QuestInfo.1: The Knighthood Exam has begun. It's quite simple. Go to #bThe 2nd Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest, and defeat the monster in it.\r\n#b(If you fail, forfeit the quest and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: You have completed the Knighthood Exam. You are no longer a Knight-in-Training, but a full-fledged official knight. Keep your wits about you as you boldly serve the Cygnus Knights.

default.0: I will be extremely disappointed if you do not head to the #bSecond Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest and finish your Trial...

0.0: I see that you're qualified to take the Knighthood Exam. Perhaps I should re-take it as well, just to refresh myself. One must be ready to take on any challenge at a moment's notice, you know. So, are you ready to begin right now?
0.1: To pass the exam, simply head to the #bSecond Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest and defeat 30 Tiguru of Exam monsters. Now, if you want a real challenge, defeat 3 million of them. That's what I would do.
0.2: Once you've defeated 30, I will officially recognize you as a knight. Now go and prove yourself.\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to #m130020000# automatically.)#k#n

no.0: If you have doubts, squash them, then let me know that you're ready to begin.
